In September 2016 I had the honour and pleasure of spending some time with Zen Master Doshin in Denver Colorado. We spoke openly and in depth about shadow – the unconscious aspect of the personality which the conscious ego does not identify in itself – and its complex and paradoxical relationship with Enlightenment.

The video contains highlights of our conversation, and the audio below goes deeper into the themes we explored together.
